fusions.name: Grain Cutter
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 9 damage, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt. It uses up to 3 charges, and kills return one.

fusions.name: Last Cut
fusions.desc: A curved cut that deals 16 damage and uses up every affliction on the target, adding 0.6 times their remaining damage. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Harvest Mend
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40%. It has a 12% chance to heal critically.

fusions.name: Gleaned Strength
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you restore 8 stamina. Once every 4 seconds.
